terms.title: Terms
terms.markdown:
## About this site

You may not copy, republish or sell the content without the author's written permission, unless a licence stated on the site says you can.

## Using the site as it is

The site is provided as it is. The author works to keep it accurate and available, but does not promise that it is free of errors, always online, or right for any particular purpose. Nothing on the site is professional, legal, medical or financial advice. To the extent the law allows, the author is not liable for any loss that results from using the site or relying on its content. Nothing in these terms limits a liability that the law does not allow to be limited.

## Comments and other contributions

If the site lets you react or comment, please be civil. Do not post anything unlawful, abusive, harassing, misleading or spam, or anything that infringes someone else's rights. You are responsible for what you post. The author may remove any contribution, or stop accepting them, at any time and without notice.

## Links to other sites

The site may link to other websites. The author does not control them and is not responsible for their content or practices.

## Changes to these terms

The author may update these terms from time to time. The version on this page is the one that applies when you use the site, so please check back now and then.

## Contact

Questions about the site or these terms go to the author. Use the contact details on the site, such as the About page or the author's profile.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.markdown:
## What this page covers

This page explains what the site itself collects when you read it. What is collected by reactions, comments or analytics, who handles it, and what choices you have are described in the section at the end of this page, for the features the site has switched on.

## Server logs

The site is delivered by a hosting provider. Like almost every web host, it keeps ordinary request logs: your IP address, the time of the request, the page you asked for and basic details about your browser. These logs are used to run and protect the service and are kept for the provider's own retention period. The author does not use them to identify individual readers.

## Browser storage

The site stores a few small settings in your browser: your colour mode (light, dark or system) and any posts you have saved to read later. This information stays on your device. The site itself keeps no reader accounts and does not track you across other websites.

## Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to ask what personal information is held about you, to have it corrected or deleted, or to object to how it is used. To use these rights, or with any privacy question, contact the author using the contact details on the site.

## Changes to this page

The author may update this page from time to time. The version shown here is the current one.
